external_publication_fact_preserved: CH1-CH7 confirmed published; CH8 not confirmed published

artifact_io.reason: Novel Writing persists canonical project/checkpoint state, Canon/prose/review artifacts, publication/signing facts and migration references whose identity, freshness, invalidation and retention are governed explicitly.

operational_hygiene.reason: The owner has release hard gates, reminder-dependency repair, signing-feedback recovery, incident/review evidence, stale-dependent-hash handling, deterministic release-evidence validation and periodic regression before release/promotion.

evolution.reason: The owner performs durable system learning from user feedback, platform signing outcomes, accepted/rejected review evidence and reader/platform evidence, and records non-trivial system evolution with candidate critique, regression evidence and explicit inference boundaries.

hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: hash-bound project reviews/acceptance/execution-evidence/checkpoints plus platform-signing audits, audits/ and CHANGELOG.md
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: SKILL.md release-hard-gate reminder-dependency rule plus platform signing-feedback loop: user/platform quality failure triggers bounded diagnosis, repair and regression without requiring the user to enumerate the internal maintenance steps
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: continuity/ARTIFACT_CONTEXT_GOVERNANCE.json#superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule with published FINAL/Canon retention and dependency checks
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: SKILL.md release hard gates plus runtime/recovery_guard.py, runtime/release_evidence_guard.py and signing-readiness gates: no release/signing promotion on missing evidence, stale dependent hashes, unresolved BLOCKER/HIGH findings, false isolation claims, unverified local Context Pack hashes, or an ungated retry after a signing rejection
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: audits/ for non-trivial system-learning passes plus project reviews/platform evidence referenced by the active project
hook_bindings.eval_or_regression_promotion_path: SKILL.md release/signing gates + runtime/recovery_guard.py + runtime/release_evidence_guard.py + owner CI; system learning is promoted only after relevant regression/evidence and must not overwrite project facts
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: continuity/ARTIFACT_CONTEXT_GOVERNANCE.json#superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule; old Library/Notion/Drive executable material remains retired and cannot regain authority by presence

overrides.evaluator_selection: Novel evolution is judged through chapter/project-specific role-separated review, identity regression, platform signing/reader evidence, periodic long-form/Canon checks and real reader/platform evidence when available; normal same-session review does not claim ATTESTED_ISOLATED assurance

methodology_assurance.boundary: Repository regression proves signing-feedback state, repair gates and deterministic recovery are wired. It does not prove the repaired front arc will pass Fanqie signing. The generic rejection does not establish a hidden AI/safety/plagiarism cause. CH9+ still requires per-chapter execution evidence, and ATTESTED_ISOLATED remains unavailable without a distinct execution identity/provider trace.
